standard_prerequisites.name: The vanishing of local cohomology above the dimension of the support and the bound cd(A, I) \leq dim(A)
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author lemma lemma-cd-dimension, whose statement is reproduced verbatim as a context span of this card (source lines 758-764)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the a priori bound for the pair of ideals and the vanishing at the non-maximal prime.

standard_prerequisites.name: The criterion for the comparison map between two local cohomology modules to be surjective in terms of the vanishing of the local cohomology at the primes of the difference
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author lemma lemma-isomorphism, whose statement is reproduced verbatim as a context span of this card (source lines 485-506)
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the vanishing needed for cd(A, I) < d to a surjectivity statement on the top local cohomology of the ring.

core_obligations: Bound the target: the context lemma gives cd(A, I) \leq d for the larger ideal, so it suffices to produce a vanishing in degree d (proof line 3583)
Plan the use of the criterion: the proof announces that the surjectivity of the comparison map on the top local cohomology of the ring will finish the argument (proof lines 3584-3588)

Verify the hypothesis of the criterion: for a prime in V(I) outside V(I'), the assumption that I' lies in the Jacobson radical forces the prime not to be maximal, so the local ring has dimension below d and its d-th local cohomology vanishes by the context lemma; surjectivity follows (proof lines 3588-3593)
proof_roadmap: 由 lemma-cd-dimension 得 cd(A,I) ≤ d，故只需证 H^d_{V(I)}(A) = 0；计划是用 lemma-isomorphism 证明 H^d_{V(I')}(A) → H^d_{V(I)}(A) 满，再由 cd(A,I') < d 得左边为 0。
取 p ∈ V(I)∖V(I')：由 I' 含于 Jacobson 根，p 不是极大理想，故 dim(A_p) < d，从而 H^d_{pA_p}(A_p) = 0（再用 lemma-cd-dimension），满足判据的假设。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement propagates a strict bound on cohomological dimension along an inclusion of ideals: if the smaller ideal lies in the Jacobson radical and already has cohomological dimension below the dimension of the ring, then so does the larger ideal (author lemma at source lines 3575-3580, label lemma-cd-top-vanishing). The proof (source lines 3582-3594) reduces the claim to the vanishing of the top local cohomology of the ring through the surjectivity criterion of the comparison map between two supports, and verifies that criterion prime by prime using the Jacobson radical hypothesis and the dimension bound for local cohomology (source lines 3588-3593). The reduction through the comparison map is the content; both input statements are reproduced as context spans because this snapshot does not carry their proofs. H2.
